title: Hydro-treatment of wild bitter apricot kernel oil: a cheap and cost-effective alternative for reducing toxicity and enhancing quality
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,1073-1082
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00543D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Swati Joia, Himanshi Rao, Raashid Ahmad Siddiqi, Tajendra Pal Singh
Hydro-treatment effectively removes amygdalin from bitter apricot kernel oil without altering its yield, quality, antioxidant activity and fatty acid profile, offering a safe and eco-friendly method for producing edible wild apricot kernel oil.
